source.name: KMA ASOS Daily Weather API
source.mode: monthly previous-year planning baseline until API key is configured
source.note: These are same-month planning baselines for launch. Production can replace them with exact same-period previous-year observations from the KMA ASOS API once a service key is configured.

January.range: cold and dry, with freezing mornings and possible icy sidewalks
January.outdoorAdvice: For outdoor queues and palace routes, keep indoor alternatives nearby and check wind chill before leaving.

February.range: cold late-winter weather, slowly brighter but still below freezing at times
February.outdoorAdvice: Plan shorter outdoor stops and use cafes, museums, or department stores between event visits.

March.range: early spring swings, chilly mornings, milder afternoons, and fine-dust checks
March.outdoorAdvice: For flower, culture, or shopping routes, check temperature gaps between day and evening.

April.range: mild spring weather with blossom crowds, dust risk, and occasional rain
April.outdoorAdvice: Outdoor festivals are easier to combine with walking routes, but rain and air quality can change plans.

May.range: warm spring to early-summer weather, good for outdoor festivals but UV rises
May.outdoorAdvice: For parks, pop-up queues, and river events, check UV and late-afternoon temperature before leaving.

June.range: warm, increasingly humid, rain risk rising
June.outdoorAdvice: For outdoor plazas, pop-up queues, and palace routes, check same-day rain and UV before leaving.

July.range: hot, humid, and monsoon-prone, with sudden heavy rain possible
July.outdoorAdvice: Avoid long exposed queues at midday and keep indoor backup stops near malls or museums.

August.range: very hot and humid, with storm and heat-advisory risk
August.outdoorAdvice: For K-pop or shopping events, arrive early, hydrate, and check official heat or crowd-control notices.

September.range: late-summer to early-autumn weather, still warm with typhoon-season rain risk
September.outdoorAdvice: Outdoor festivals are pleasant after sunset, but monitor rain and transport changes.

October.range: comfortable autumn weather with cooler evenings and high walking demand
October.outdoorAdvice: A strong month for festival hopping; book popular routes and photo spots early.

November.range: cool late autumn turning cold, with crisp evenings
November.outdoorAdvice: Plan indoor stops after sunset and check closing times for outdoor attractions.

December.range: cold winter weather, dry air, and possible freezing evenings
December.outdoorAdvice: For holiday markets, pop-ups, and shopping routes, shorten outdoor waits and use subway-connected venues.

January.range: cool coastal winter, usually milder than Seoul but windy near water
January.outdoorAdvice: Waterfront events can feel colder than the forecast, so plan wind protection and transit time.

February.range: cool late-winter coastal weather with chilly mornings
February.outdoorAdvice: Combine indoor markets, cafes, and museums with shorter beach or harbor stops.

March.range: mild early spring by the coast, with wind and temperature swings
March.outdoorAdvice: Good for seaside walks, but check wind when planning outdoor queues or photo routes.

April.range: mild spring coastal weather, comfortable for festivals and harbor routes
April.outdoorAdvice: Outdoor events pair well with beaches and markets, but allow extra time on crowded weekends.

May.range: warm and breezy, good for seaside festivals before peak summer humidity
May.outdoorAdvice: Plan sunset waterfront stops and check event crowd notices near beach districts.

June.range: warm coastal weather, humidity and evening crowd risk
June.outdoorAdvice: For stadium and waterfront events, plan post-event transit and allow time for crowds near beaches and stations.

July.range: hot, humid, and rainy, with beach crowds and sudden showers
July.outdoorAdvice: For beach or festival plans, check rain, waves, and crowd-control updates before leaving.

August.range: peak summer heat and humidity, busy beaches, and storm risk
August.outdoorAdvice: Keep indoor cooling breaks and avoid long midday waits near exposed waterfront areas.

September.range: warm early autumn with possible typhoon-season rain
September.outdoorAdvice: Good for festivals and night views, but check transport and weather alerts on rain days.

October.range: comfortable autumn coastal weather, strong for festivals and outdoor concerts
October.outdoorAdvice: Book transport early for major festival weekends and leave extra time after concerts.

November.range: cool coastal autumn, breezy evenings near beaches and bridges
November.outdoorAdvice: Night views are pleasant but windy; pair outdoor stops with indoor dining or markets.

December.range: cool to cold coastal winter with windier waterfront conditions
December.outdoorAdvice: For winter lights and shopping routes, plan warm-up stops around stations and markets.

January.range: winter varies by region; inland areas can be far colder than coastal cities
January.outdoorAdvice: Use this as a reminder to check the event city forecast, road conditions, and official venue notices.

February.range: late winter with regional cold snaps and dry air
February.outdoorAdvice: Confirm local forecasts and keep indoor alternatives for long waits.

March.range: spring transition, temperature gaps, and fine-dust checks vary by city
March.outdoorAdvice: Check the event city forecast and air quality before planning outdoor-heavy routes.

April.range: mild spring, blossom crowds, regional rain, and dust risk
April.outdoorAdvice: Use city-specific weather and official notices for festivals, parks, and long-distance travel.

May.range: warm spring to early summer, with rising UV and busy festival weekends
May.outdoorAdvice: Check local UV, heat, and crowd notices before committing to outdoor queues.

June.range: regional variation; city-specific weather check required
June.outdoorAdvice: Use this as a pre-trip reminder, then confirm local forecasts and official venue notices.

July.range: hot, humid, and monsoon-prone across many regions
July.outdoorAdvice: Confirm rain alerts, transport changes, and indoor backup options before travel.

August.range: peak heat and humidity, with regional storm and heat-advisory risk
August.outdoorAdvice: Check heat advisories and event crowd guidance, especially for outdoor festivals.

September.range: late-summer to autumn transition with possible typhoon-season rain
September.outdoorAdvice: Use official transport and weather alerts when planning intercity event trips.

October.range: comfortable autumn weather, but mountain and coastal areas cool differently
October.outdoorAdvice: A strong month for travel routes; book busy weekends early and check evening temperatures.

November.range: cool late autumn, with colder inland evenings
November.outdoorAdvice: Plan indoor breaks and check last transport times for regional events.

December.range: winter weather with regional snow, dry air, and cold nights
December.outdoorAdvice: Confirm city-specific weather, road conditions, and official event status before departure.

January.range: cold coastal winter near the airport, with wind making queues feel colder
January.outdoorAdvice: For airport-area arenas and Songdo routes, plan indoor waiting points and allow extra transfer time.

February.range: cold late-winter coastal weather, windy around bridges and open venues
February.outdoorAdvice: Keep outdoor walks short and use airport, mall, or station-connected breaks between event stops.

March.range: early spring with chilly mornings, milder afternoons, and coastal wind
March.outdoorAdvice: For Songdo, airport, or arena plans, check evening wind and last transport before leaving.

April.range: mild spring with coastal breeze, dust checks, and occasional rain
April.outdoorAdvice: Good for Songdo and open-air festival routes, but leave buffer time on windy or rainy days.

May.range: warm spring to early-summer weather, usually breezy near the coast
May.outdoorAdvice: Outdoor festivals are manageable, but airport-area transfers can take longer than Seoul routes.

June.range: warm and increasingly humid, with rain risk rising around coastal and airport areas
June.outdoorAdvice: For arena concerts, prepare rain gear and a post-show return plan before heading to Yeongjong or Songdo.

July.range: hot, humid, and monsoon-prone, with sudden heavy rain and flight-area wind possible
July.outdoorAdvice: Avoid exposed waits before concerts and keep indoor backup time around terminals, malls, or stations.

August.range: very hot and humid, with storm, heat-advisory, and coastal wind risk
August.outdoorAdvice: For airport-area events, confirm shuttle, taxi, and late-night transit options before queues build.

September.range: late-summer to early-autumn weather with typhoon-season rain risk
September.outdoorAdvice: Monitor rain and wind alerts for bridges, ferries, airport routes, and outdoor festival sites.

October.range: comfortable autumn weather with cooler breezy evenings near the coast
October.outdoorAdvice: A strong month for Songdo and music festivals; plan late-return transport before evening events.

November.range: cool late autumn, turning colder and windier after sunset
November.outdoorAdvice: Pair outdoor stops with indoor shopping, cafe, or airport-area breaks and check last trains.

December.range: cold coastal winter with dry air and wind around open arena approaches
December.outdoorAdvice: For concerts and winter routes, shorten outdoor waits and keep taxi or airport railroad backup options.
